printer_technology.label: Printer technology
printer_technology.description: Printing process family this machine describes. FFF builds by extruding filament; SLA cures resin. Bambu Studio machine presets are FFF.

printable_area.label: Printable area
printable_area.description: Bed outline as a closed polygon of 'XxY' millimetre points, four corners for a rectangular bed. Bounds where objects may sit and fixes the origin all g-code coordinates are relative to.

extruder_printable_area.label: Extruder printable area
extruder_printable_area.description: Per-extruder reachable outline, one entry per extruder, each a comma-joined list of 'XxY' points. Narrows printable_area for a toolhead that cannot cover the whole bed.

bed_exclude_area.label: Bed exclude area
bed_exclude_area.description: Bed regions objects may not occupy, as 'XxY' polygon points. Covers fixed hardware such as a purge chute or nozzle wiper. Empty when the whole bed is usable.

bed_custom_texture.label: Bed custom texture
bed_custom_texture.description: Path to an image drawn on the bed surface in the 3D scene. Cosmetic; no effect on slicing.

bed_custom_model.label: Bed custom model
bed_custom_model.description: Path to a 3D model used to draw the bed in the scene. Cosmetic; no effect on slicing.

printable_height.label: Printable height
printable_height.description: Highest Z (mm) the toolhead can reach. Objects taller than this cannot be sliced. Machine-specific; around 250 on most Bambu machines.

extruder_printable_height.label: Extruder printable height
extruder_printable_height.description: Per-extruder maximum Z in mm; a 'nil' column keeps the machine-wide printable_height. Lower for a toolhead mounted higher than its sibling.

print_host.label: Hostname, IP or URL
print_host.description: Hostname, IP address, or URL of the network print host g-code is uploaded to. Paired with host_type.

print_host_webui.label: Device UI
print_host_webui.description: URL of the print host's web interface. Convenience link only; no effect on slicing or upload.

printhost_apikey.label: API Key / Password
printhost_apikey.description: API key or password authenticating uploads to print_host. Blank when the host needs no credentials.

printhost_port.label: Printer
printhost_port.description: Printer identifier on the print host when that host serves several machines or queues.

printhost_cafile.label: HTTPS CA File
printhost_cafile.description: Path to a CA certificate bundle used to validate the print host's HTTPS certificate. Blank uses the system trust store.

printhost_user.label: User
printhost_user.description: User name for print hosts using user/password authorization; see printhost_authorization_type.

printhost_password.label: Password
printhost_password.description: Password paired with printhost_user for user/password print-host authorization.

printhost_ssl_ignore_revoke.label: Ignore HTTPS certificate revocation checks
printhost_ssl_ignore_revoke.description: Skips HTTPS certificate revocation checking when uploading to print_host. Reserve for intranet hosts whose certificates cannot be checked.

printhost_authorization_type.label: Authorization Type
printhost_authorization_type.description: How print_host authenticates uploads. key: the single API key in printhost_apikey; user: printhost_user plus printhost_password.

before_layer_change_gcode.label: Before layer change G-code
before_layer_change_gcode.description: Custom g-code emitted just before the Z move that starts a layer. Placeholders such as [layer_num] and [layer_z] expand. Runs earlier than layer_change_gcode.

upward_compatible_machine.label: upward compatible machine
upward_compatible_machine.description: Names of newer machine profiles that can also run prints sliced for this one. Lets Studio offer the job to a compatible printer.

default_filament_profile.label: Default filament profile
default_filament_profile.description: Filament preset selected by default for each extruder when this machine is chosen. Per extruder.

default_print_profile.label: Default process profile
default_print_profile.description: Process preset selected by default when this machine is chosen.

machine_end_gcode.label: End G-code
machine_end_gcode.default:
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
G28 X0  ; home X axis
M84     ; disable motors
machine_end_gcode.description: G-code appended after the last layer. Typically turns off heaters, retracts, parks the head, and disables motors.

printing_by_object_gcode.label: Between Object Gcode
printing_by_object_gcode.description: G-code inserted between objects when printing sequentially, after one object finishes and before the next starts.

extruder_clearance_height_to_rod.label: Height to rod
extruder_clearance_height_to_rod.description: Vertical clearance (mm) from the nozzle tip up to the gantry rods. Caps how tall a finished object may be when the head passes over it in sequential printing.

extruder_clearance_height_to_lid.label: Height to lid
extruder_clearance_height_to_lid.description: Vertical clearance (mm) from the nozzle tip to the lid or top frame. Second height limit on object height in sequential printing.

extruder_clearance_dist_to_rod.label: Distance to rod
extruder_clearance_dist_to_rod.description: Horizontal clearance (mm) from the nozzle to the gantry rods. Used with the height clearances to space objects printed one at a time.

nozzle_height.label: Nozzle height
nozzle_height.description: Height (mm) of the nozzle cone below the hotend body. Sets how close to a finished wall the head may travel without the heatsink striking it.

extruder_clearance_max_radius.label: Max Radius
extruder_clearance_max_radius.description: Radius (mm) of the toolhead's largest horizontal footprint. Minimum spacing between objects in sequential printing.

grab_length.label: Grab length
grab_length.description: Filament length (mm) the extruder gear pulls back to park the tip inside the toolhead when unloading. Per extruder.

extruder_colour.label: Extruder Color
extruder_colour.description: Display colour per extruder as a hex string (#RRGGBB). Preview only; no effect on slicing.

extruder_offset.label: Extruder offset
extruder_offset.description: Nozzle offset per extruder as 'XxY' millimetres from the machine origin. Non-zero for a second toolhead; the slicer compensates every move by it.

printer_notes.label: Printer notes
printer_notes.description: Free-text notes stored with the machine preset. Ignored by slicing; useful for hardware mods and calibration history.

physical_extruder_map.description: Maps each logical extruder to the physical extruder driving it. Identity on single-toolhead machines.

machine_load_filament_time.label: Filament load time
machine_load_filament_time.description: Seconds the machine needs to load filament. Estimation only; feeds the printing-time prediction for multi-material jobs.

machine_unload_filament_time.label: Filament unload time
machine_unload_filament_time.description: Seconds the machine needs to unload filament. Estimation only; feeds time prediction for filament changes.

machine_switch_extruder_time.label: Extruder switch time
machine_switch_extruder_time.description: Seconds to switch between toolheads on a multi-extruder machine. Estimation only.

machine_hotend_change_time.label: Hotend change time
machine_hotend_change_time.description: Seconds to swap a hotend. Estimation only.

group_algo_with_time.description: Lets the filament-grouping algorithm weigh estimated time alongside material waste when assigning filaments to extruders.

machine_prepare_compensation_time.description: Seconds of machine preparation — homing, bed levelling, purge — added to the estimated print time ahead of the first layer.

hotend_cooling_rate.description: Hotend cooling rate in °C per second, per extruder. Feeds the pre-heat scheduler so a temperature drop is started early enough.

hotend_heating_rate.description: Hotend heating rate in °C per second, per extruder. Used with enable_pre_heating to begin heating ahead of the move that needs the new temperature.

enable_pre_heating.description: Starts hotend temperature changes early, using hotend_heating_rate and hotend_cooling_rate, so the nozzle is at target when the change is due. Cuts idle waiting on multi-filament prints.

support_object_skip_flush.description: Lets the machine purge into an object already being printed instead of the wipe tower or chute during a filament change. Saves material where the object can absorb it.

bed_temperature_formula.label: Bed temperature type
bed_temperature_formula.description: How the bed target is chosen when several filaments print together. by_first_filament takes the first filament's bed temperature; by_highest_temp takes the highest requested — safer for adhesion, riskier for low-temperature materials.

nozzle_flush_dataset.description: Index of the calibrated flushing-volume dataset used per extruder. Selects the purge amounts applied at filament changes.

scan_first_layer.label: Scan first layer
scan_first_layer.description: Runs the machine's first-layer inspection scan after layer one. Catches adhesion failures early at a small time cost.

print_in_clockwise.label: Print loops in clockwise
print_in_clockwise.description: Prints perimeter loops clockwise rather than counter-clockwise. Changes which side the seam falls on and the direction overhangs are laid down.

wrapping_detection_layers.label: Clumping detection layers
wrapping_detection_layers.description: Layers between clumping-detection probe checks. Lower checks more often at some time cost; 20 default.

wrapping_exclude_area.label: Probing exclude area of clumping
wrapping_exclude_area.description: Bed region the clumping-detection probe must skip, as 'XxY' polygon points. Covers hardware the probe cannot touch.

thumbnail_size.label: Thumbnail size
thumbnail_size.description: Preview thumbnail dimensions embedded in the g-code, as 'WxH' pixels. Must match what the printer's screen expects.

nozzle_type.label: Nozzle type
nozzle_type.description: Nozzle material per extruder. hardened_steel and tungsten_carbide survive abrasive filaments (carbon- or glass-filled); stainless_steel and brass conduct heat better and suit plain polymers. Studio blocks abrasive filaments on brass.

printer_structure.label: Printer structure
printer_structure.description: Motion system topology. corexy moves the head in XY on crossed belts while the bed drops; i3 moves the bed in Y; hbot uses a single H-shaped belt; delta uses three parallel arms. Determines which acceleration and jerk limits are realistic.

best_object_pos.label: Best object position
best_object_pos.description: Preferred object placement as bed fractions, 'XxY' in 0-1. Studio centres a single object here; useful when part of the bed is flatter or better cooled.

auxiliary_fan.label: Auxiliary part cooling fan
auxiliary_fan.description: Declares that the machine has an auxiliary (side) part-cooling fan, enabling the filament and process keys that drive it.

fan_direction.label: Fan direction
fan_direction.description: Side the auxiliary fan blows from. Lets the slicer bias seam and overhang placement relative to the airflow.

support_chamber_temp_control.label: Support control chamber temperature
support_chamber_temp_control.description: Declares that the machine can hold a chamber temperature target, enabling chamber_temperature handling in filament presets.

support_air_filtration.label: Air filtration enhancement
support_air_filtration.description: Declares that the machine has an exhaust or filtration fan, enabling the filament keys that run it during and after printing.

support_cooling_filter.description: Declares that the machine has a cooling filter unit; prerequisite for cooling_filter_enabled.

cooling_filter_enabled.label: Use cooling filter
cooling_filter_enabled.description: Runs the machine's cooling filter while printing. Requires support_cooling_filter.

gcode_flavor.label: G-code flavor
gcode_flavor.description: G-code dialect emitted for this machine — marlin and marlin2 for Marlin firmware, klipper for Klipper, reprapfirmware for Duet, and so on. The wrong flavor yields commands the firmware ignores or rejects.

inherits.label: Inherits profile
inherits.description: Name of the parent system preset this profile derives from. Profile stores only keys that differ; unset keys follow the parent, including after parent updates. Empty means a standalone full profile.

layer_change_gcode.label: Layer change G-code
layer_change_gcode.description: Custom g-code emitted at the start of each layer, after the Z move. Placeholders such as [layer_num] and [layer_z] expand. See before_layer_change_gcode for the earlier hook.

time_lapse_gcode.label: Time lapse G-code
time_lapse_gcode.description: G-code emitted once per layer to capture a timelapse frame, typically parking the head and triggering the camera.

wrapping_detection_gcode.label: Clumping detection G-code
wrapping_detection_gcode.description: G-code run every wrapping_detection_layers layers to probe for filament clumping around the nozzle. Empty disables the check.

silent_mode.label: Supports silent mode
silent_mode.description: Declares that the machine offers a quiet motion mode running under its own, lower, machine limits.

machine_pause_gcode.label: Pause G-code
machine_pause_gcode.description: G-code emitted where a pause is inserted, usually parking the head and waiting for the operator.

template_custom_gcode.label: Custom G-code
template_custom_gcode.description: Reusable custom g-code block shipped with the machine that a process preset can reference.

extruder_max_nozzle_count.description: Nozzles the extruder can carry, per extruder. Above one only on toolheads with switchable nozzles.

machine_min_extruding_rate.description: Lowest feedrate (mm/s) the firmware honours while extruding; slower moves are clamped up to it. 0 disables the floor.

machine_min_travel_rate.description: Lowest feedrate (mm/s) the firmware honours for non-extruding travel. 0 disables the floor.

machine_max_acceleration_extruding.description: Firmware acceleration cap (mm/s²) for extruding moves. Clamps whatever the process preset requests; raising it past what the frame can take brings ringing and skipped steps. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_acceleration_retracting.description: Firmware acceleration cap (mm/s²) for retraction moves. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_acceleration_travel.description: Firmware acceleration cap (mm/s²) for travel moves — usually the highest of the three, since nothing is being laid down. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

max_layer_height.label: Max
max_layer_height.description: Largest layer height (mm) the extruder may print, per extruder. 0 means 75% of nozzle_diameter. Caps adaptive and per-object layer heights.

min_layer_height.label: Min
min_layer_height.description: Smallest layer height (mm) the extruder may print, per extruder. Floor for adaptive layer height; 0.07 typical for a 0.4 nozzle.

nozzle_diameter.label: Nozzle diameter
nozzle_diameter.description: Nozzle bore in mm, per extruder. Sets the usable line-width and layer-height range: 0.4 standard, 0.2 for fine detail, 0.6-0.8 for speed and strength.

host_type.label: Host Type
host_type.description: Print host software running at print_host — octoprint, prusalink, duet, repetier and friends. Determines which upload API is used.

nozzle_volume.label: Nozzle volume
nozzle_volume.description: Melt-zone volume (mm³) inside the hotend, per extruder. Sets how much filament must be purged to fully change colour or material.

printer_model.label: Printer type
printer_model.description: Machine model this preset targets, such as 'Bambu Lab P1S'. Presets and filaments are matched to printers by this value.

printer_variant.label: Printer variant
printer_variant.description: Hardware variant within printer_model, conventionally the nozzle diameter ('0.4'). Distinguishes one model's per-nozzle machine presets.

retraction_minimum_travel.label: Travel distance threshold
retraction_minimum_travel.description: Shortest travel move (mm) that triggers a retraction, per extruder. Raising it skips retractions on short hops, saving time and filament grinding at some risk of stringing.

retract_before_wipe.label: Retract amount before wipe
retract_before_wipe.description: Share of the retraction (percent) performed before the wipe move starts, per extruder. 100% retracts fully then wipes; lower values retract during the wipe, smearing less but oozing more.

retract_when_changing_layer.label: Retract when change layer
retract_when_changing_layer.description: Retracts at every layer change, per extruder. Reduces the blob at the Z seam at the cost of one retraction per layer.

retraction_length.label: Length
retraction_length.description: Filament pulled back (mm) on retraction, per extruder. Too little strings; too much grinds the filament and leaves gaps on restart. Direct drive 0.4-1.2 mm, bowden 2-6 mm.

enable_long_retraction_when_cut.description: Enables the long retraction performed when the filament is cut at a change. 0 off, 1 on; depends on the machine having a cutter.

long_retractions_when_cut.label: Long retraction when cut(experimental)
long_retractions_when_cut.description: Performs the long retraction when the filament is cut, per extruder. Pulls the tip clear of the melt zone so the next filament loads cleanly.

retraction_distances_when_cut.label: Retraction distance when cut
retraction_distances_when_cut.description: Distance (mm) pulled back during the cut retraction, per extruder. Must carry the tip past the cutter; 10-18 mm.

retract_length_toolchange.label: Length
retract_length_toolchange.description: Filament pulled back (mm) when switching to another extruder, per extruder. Longer than an ordinary retraction because the tip must clear the melt zone entirely.

z_hop.label: Z hop when retract
z_hop.description: Height (mm) the nozzle lifts for travel after retracting, per extruder. Stops the tip dragging over printed material; costs time and can string. 0.2-0.4 mm typical, 0 disables.

retract_lift_above.label: Z hop lower boundary
retract_lift_above.description: Lowest Z (mm) at which z_hop applies, per extruder. Raise it to skip hopping on the first layers, where there is nothing to collide with.

retract_lift_below.label: Z hop upper boundary
retract_lift_below.description: Highest Z (mm) at which z_hop applies, per extruder. 0 means no upper bound.

z_hop_types.label: Z Hop Type
z_hop_types.description: How the lift is performed, per extruder. Auto Lift lets the slicer choose per move; Normal Lift goes straight up then travels; Slope Lift climbs along the travel direction; Spiral Lift climbs helically, gentlest on the print. Slope and Spiral cost less time than Normal.

extruder_type.label: Type
extruder_type.description: Extruder drive layout per extruder. Direct Drive mounts the gears at the hotend and needs short retractions; Bowden pushes through a long tube and needs far longer ones.

default_nozzle_volume_type.label: Default Nozzle Volume Type
default_nozzle_volume_type.description: Nozzle volume class selected by default for each extruder, such as standard or high flow. Picks which calibrated flow and purge data apply.

extruder_variant_list.description: Every extruder variant this machine supports, as 'drive type + nozzle volume' strings. printer_extruder_variant picks from this list.

printer_extruder_id.description: Extruder index each printer_extruder_variant column belongs to. Lets one physical extruder carry several variants.

printer_extruder_variant.description: Active extruder variant per column, such as 'Direct Drive Standard'. Its length is the column count every per-extruder vector key in presets for this machine must match.

master_extruder_id.description: Index of the extruder treated as primary. It prints first and supplies the machine-wide defaults.

retract_restart_extra.label: Extra length on restart
retract_restart_extra.description: Extra filament (mm) pushed beyond the retraction when printing resumes, per extruder. Small positive values fight gaps after a retraction; too much blobs. Usually 0.

retract_restart_extra_toolchange.label: Extra length on restart
retract_restart_extra_toolchange.description: Extra filament (mm) pushed on restart after a toolchange retraction, per extruder. Compensates for material lost while the extruder stood idle.

retraction_speed.label: Retraction Speed
retraction_speed.description: Speed (mm/s) at which filament is pulled back, per extruder. Faster cuts oozing but risks grinding soft filament; 30-60 mm/s typical.

deretraction_speed.label: Deretraction Speed
deretraction_speed.description: Speed (mm/s) at which retracted filament is pushed back, per extruder. 0 reuses retraction_speed. Slower helps flexibles and high-flow hotends recover cleanly.

machine_start_gcode.label: Start G-code
machine_start_gcode.default: G28 ; home all axes\nG1 Z5 F5000 ; lift nozzle\n
machine_start_gcode.description: G-code emitted before the first layer: home, heat, level, and purge. Placeholders such as [nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] expand.

single_extruder_multi_material.label: Single Extruder Multi Material
single_extruder_multi_material.description: Declares that several filaments feed one nozzle, AMS-style. Enables purge and flush handling at filament changes.

head_wrap_detect_zone.description: Bed region used by the toolhead wrap-detection routine, as 'XxY' polygon points.

change_filament_gcode.label: Change filament G-code
change_filament_gcode.description: G-code emitted at each filament change to unload, purge, and load the next filament. Placeholders identify the outgoing and incoming filaments.

use_relative_e_distances.label: Use relative E distances
use_relative_e_distances.description: Emits extrusion-axis moves as relative distances (M83) rather than absolute (M82). Relative is the modern default and survives custom g-code that moves E on its own.

use_firmware_retraction.label: Use firmware retraction
use_firmware_retraction.description: Emits G10/G11 and lets the firmware retract using its own stored settings. The slicer's retraction lengths and speeds stop applying.

wipe.label: Wipe while retracting
wipe.description: Moves the nozzle along the path just printed while retracting, per extruder. Wipes the tip so less material oozes during travel; see wipe_distance and retract_before_wipe.

wipe_distance.label: Wipe Distance
wipe_distance.description: Length (mm) of the wipe move, per extruder. Longer wipes clean the tip better but reheat the last extrusion; 1-3 mm typical.

machine_max_speed_x.description: Firmware feedrate cap (mm/s) for the X axis. Clamps every X move whatever the process preset asks for — a hardware limit, not a tuning knob. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_speed_y.description: Firmware feedrate cap (mm/s) for the Y axis. Clamps every Y move whatever the process preset asks for. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_speed_z.description: Firmware feedrate cap (mm/s) for the Z axis. Far lower than X and Y on leadscrew-driven axes; governs how fast layer changes and z hops move. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_speed_e.description: Firmware feedrate cap (mm/s) for the extruder axis. Bounds retraction and deretraction speeds however high the extruder keys are set. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_acceleration_x.description: Firmware acceleration cap (mm/s²) for the X axis. Clamps the process preset's accelerations; beyond what the frame tolerates it brings ringing and skipped steps. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_acceleration_y.description: Firmware acceleration cap (mm/s²) for the Y axis. On a bed-slinger this is the axis that moves the print, so it is usually the tighter of X and Y. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_acceleration_z.description: Firmware acceleration cap (mm/s²) for the Z axis. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_acceleration_e.description: Firmware acceleration cap (mm/s²) for the extruder axis. Governs how sharply retractions can start and stop. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_jerk_x.description: Firmware jerk limit (mm/s) for the X axis — the largest instantaneous speed change allowed at a corner. Higher keeps corners fast but rings; lower is smoother and slower. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_jerk_y.description: Firmware jerk limit (mm/s) for the Y axis: the largest instantaneous speed change allowed at a corner. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_jerk_z.description: Firmware jerk limit (mm/s) for the Z axis. Small, since leadscrews tolerate little abrupt change. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.

machine_max_jerk_e.description: Firmware jerk limit (mm/s) for the extruder axis. Bounds how abruptly retraction can reverse the filament. A 'nil' column keeps the inherited value.
